rarityUpgrade.description: Cascading rarity upgrade system - items can upgrade to next tier with exponentially decreasing probability

itemAffixByRarity.description: Affix rolls: rarity sets how many chances an item gets at an affix line (affixRolls, Common 1 .. Mythic 6); each lands at affixRollChance (row override or the default below), so any roll can come up empty. Hits split across affixPoolWeights (prefix lines capped at 2; action weight 0 = gear actions keep their own min/max/chance). Magic find raises the per-roll chance. Material is always on and is not an affix. Rarity mix comes from RarityTable.json.
